harness.note: /tmp scratch is ephemeral; harness text embedded for re-run
harness.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# S47 adversarial harness — souji-shokunin round 2, tools/souji-verify.sh
# Cases: identical/independent add+delete resurrection, git submodule path,
#        circular symlink (+ controls). Emits JSON with per-case raw evidence.
# usage: adv47.sh [out.json]     (default /tmp/adv-47/adv47.json)
set -euo pipefail

REPO="/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin"
TOOL="${SOUJI_VERIFY_TOOL:-$REPO/tools/souji-verify.sh}"
OUT="${1:-/tmp/adv-47/adv47.json}"
SELFDIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
TMOUT_S=45
SCRATCH="$(mktemp -d /tmp/adv47.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$SCRATCH"' EXIT
JSONL="$SCRATCH/cases.jsonl"
ERRF="$SCRATCH/stderr.txt"
: > "$JSONL"

export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=adv47 GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=adv47@test.invalid
export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=adv47 GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=adv47@test.invalid
DAY=0
tick() { DAY=$((DAY + 1)); export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE GIT_COMMITTER_DATE; GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="2026-01-$(printf '%02d' "$DAY")T00:00:00+00:00"; GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="$GIT_AUTHOR_DATE"; }
gitq() { git -c commit.gpgsign=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null "$@"; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- fixtures --
build_r1() { # resurrection family
  local S W
  S="$SCRATCH/r1"; W="$S/work"
  mkdir -p "$S"
  gitq init -q --bare -b master "$S/R1.git"
  gitq init -q -b master "$W"
  git -C "$W" remote add origin "$S/R1.git"
  printf 'v1\n' > "$W/kp.txt"; printf 'v1\n' > "$W/rl.txt"
  printf 'v1\n' > "$W/gh.txt"; printf 'v1\n' > "$W/gh2.txt"
  printf 'ctrl\n' > "$W/ctrl.txt"; printf 'm1\n' > "$W/mod.txt"
  git -C "$W" add -A; tick; gitq -C "$W" commit -q -m "c1 add six"
  git -C "$W" push -q -u origin master
  rm "$W/kp.txt" "$W/rl.txt" "$W/gh.txt" "$W/gh2.txt"
  git -C "$W" add -A; tick; gitq -C "$W" commit -q -m "c2 delete four"; git -C "$W" push -q
  printf 'v1\n' > "$W/kp.txt"; git -C "$W" add -A; tick
  gitq -C "$W" commit -q -m "c3 re-add kp identical (pushed)"; git -C "$W" push -q
  printf 'v1\n' > "$W/rl.txt"; git -C "$W" add -A; tick
  gitq -C "$W" commit -q -m "c4 re-add rl identical (LOCAL ONLY)"
  printf 'v1\n' > "$W/gh.txt"            # untracked, identical to c1 blob
  printf 'v2-new\n' > "$W/gh2.txt"       # untracked, never committed bytes
  printf 'm2-dirty\n' > "$W/mod.txt"     # tracked, modified, never committed
}

build_r2() { # submodule family
  local S O
  S="$SCRATCH/r2"; O="$S/outer"
  mkdir -p "$S"
  gitq init -q --bare -b master "$S/sub-origin.git"
  gitq init -q -b master "$S/subseed"
  printf 's1\n' > "$S/subseed/s1.txt"
  git -C "$S/subseed" add -A; tick; gitq -C "$S/subseed" commit -q -m "s1"
  git -C "$S/subseed" remote add origin "$S/sub-origin.git"
  git -C "$S/subseed" push -q -u origin master
  gitq init -q --bare -b master "$S/sub2-origin.git"
  gitq init -q -b master "$S/sub2seed"
  printf 't1\n' > "$S/sub2seed/t1.txt"
  git -C "$S/sub2seed" add -A; tick; gitq -C "$S/sub2seed" commit -q -m "t1"
  git -C "$S/sub2seed" remote add origin "$S/sub2-origin.git"
  git -C "$S/sub2seed" push -q -u origin master
  gitq init -q --bare -b master "$S/sub3-origin.git"
  gitq init -q -b master "$S/sub3seed"
  printf 'u1\n' > "$S/sub3seed/u1.txt"
  git -C "$S/sub3seed" add -A; tick; gitq -C "$S/sub3seed" commit -q -m "u1"
  git -C "$S/sub3seed" remote add origin "$S/sub3-origin.git"
  git -C "$S/sub3seed" push -q -u origin master
  gitq init -q --bare -b master "$S/outer-origin.git"
  gitq init -q -b master "$O"
  git -C "$O" remote add origin "$S/outer-origin.git"
  printf 'o1\n' > "$O/base.txt"
  git -C "$O" add -A; tick; gitq -C "$O" commit -q -m "o1 base"; git -C "$O" push -q -u origin master
  git -c protocol.file.allow=always -c commit.gpgsign=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null \
      -C "$O" submodule add -q "$S/sub-origin.git" mods/sub
  git -c protocol.file.allow=always -c commit.gpgsign=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null \
      -C "$O" submodule add -q "$S/sub2-origin.git" mods/clean
  git -c protocol.file.allow=always -c commit.gpgsign=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null \
      -C "$O" submodule add -q "$S/sub3-origin.git" mods/sub-broken
  tick; gitq -C "$O" commit -q -m "o2 add three submodules"; git -C "$O" push -q
  # inner dirty + local-only state in mods/sub
  printf 's2\n' > "$O/mods/sub/s2.txt"; git -C "$O/mods/sub" add -A; tick
  gitq -C "$O/mods/sub" commit -q -m "s2 local-only"
  printf 'dirty\n' > "$O/mods/sub/dirty.txt"
  # sub-broken: local-only commit + unpushed bytes, then break the gitfile
  printf 's2b\n' > "$O/mods/sub-broken/s2b.txt"; git -C "$O/mods/sub-broken" add -A; tick
  gitq -C "$O/mods/sub-broken" commit -q -m "s2b local-only"
  printf 'unpushed-bytes-47\n' > "$O/mods/sub-broken/unpushed-bytes.txt"
  printf 'gitdir: /nonexistent/adv47-broken-gitdir\n' > "$O/mods/sub-broken/.git"
}

build_r3() { # symlink family inside a pushed repo + a plain non-repo dir
  local S W
  S="$SCRATCH/r3"; W="$S/work3"
  mkdir -p "$S"
  gitq init -q --bare -b master "$S/R3.git"
  gitq init -q -b master "$W"
  git -C "$W" remote add origin "$S/R3.git"
  ln -s link-b "$W/link-a"; ln -s link-a "$W/link-b"
  ln -s self "$W/self"; ln -s nowhere "$W/dangling"
  mkdir "$W/circular-dir"; ln -s . "$W/circular-dir/up"
  printf 'ctrl2\n' > "$W/ctrl2.txt"
  git -C "$W" add -A; tick; gitq -C "$W" commit -q -m "c1 symlinks + ctrl2"
  git -C "$W" push -q -u origin master
  mkdir -p "$SCRATCH/plain"
  ln -s loop-b "$SCRATCH/plain/loop-a"; ln -s loop-a "$SCRATCH/plain/loop-b"
  ln -s self "$SCRATCH/plain/self"
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------- recording --
emit_case() { # env ADV_* -> JSONL row
  ADV_JSONL="$JSONL" python3 -c '
import json, os
keys = ("id","cls","description","fixture","tool_cmd","exit","stdout","stderr","lines",
        "field_count","expected","expected_detail","observed_verdict","observed_reason",
        "result","severity","notes","ground_truth","tool_sha256")
d = {k: os.environ.get("ADV_" + k.upper(), "") for k in keys}
for k in ("exit", "lines", "field_count"):
    d[k] = int(d[k]) if d[k] != "" else None
d["stdout"] = d["stdout"][:4000]; d["stderr"] = d["stderr"][:4000]
d["ground_truth"] = d["ground_truth"][:4000]
open(os.environ["ADV_JSONL"], "a").write(json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")'
}

parse_line() { # $1 -> PV PR NF
  local l="$1" f3 f4
  NF="$(printf '%s' "$l" | awk -F'\t' '{print NF}')"
  f3="$(printf '%s' "$l" | cut -f3)"; f4="$(printf '%s' "$l" | cut -f4)"
  case "$f3" in
    SAFE | SAFE\(*) PV="SAFE" ;;
    NOT-SAFE | NOT-SAFE\(*) PV="NOT-SAFE" ;;
    *) PV="?" ;;
  esac
  if [[ "$f3" == *"("* ]]; then PR="${f3#*(}"; PR="${PR%)}"; else PR="$f4"; fi
}

OBS_VERDICT=""; OBS_REASON=""; RESULT=""; SEVERITY=""; NOTES=""

classify() { # $1 rule $2 sev
  local rule="$1" sev="$2"
  RESULT="PASS"; SEVERITY=""; NOTES=""
  if [[ $RC -eq 124 ]]; then RESULT="FAIL"; SEVERITY="high"
    NOTES="HANG: killed by timeout after ${TMOUT_S}s"; return; fi
  if [[ $RC -ne 0 ]]; then RESULT="FAIL"; SEVERITY="high"
    NOTES="exit=${RC}; spec requires exit 0 on evaluated targets (stderr: $(printf '%s' "$ERR" | head -c 200))"; return; fi
  case "$rule" in
    notsafe)
      if [[ "$OBS_VERDICT" == "NOT-SAFE" ]]; then
        [[ -n "$NOTES" ]] || NOTES="ok"
      else RESULT="FAIL"; SEVERITY="$sev"; NOTES="expected NOT-SAFE, got ${OBS_VERDICT}(${OBS_REASON}); false-SAFE: pushed receipt = intro-ancestor only and ignores current tracked/dirty/untracked state (see ground_truth hashes/status)"; fi ;;
    safepushed)
      if [[ "$OBS_VERDICT" == "SAFE" && "$OBS_REASON" == *pushed* && "$OBS_REASON" != *unverifiable* ]]; then NOTES="ok"
      elif [[ "$OBS_VERDICT" == "NOT-SAFE" ]]; then RESULT="FAIL"; SEVERITY="$sev"; NOTES="expected SAFE(pushed), got NOT-SAFE(${OBS_REASON})"
      else RESULT="FAIL"; SEVERITY="$sev"; NOTES="expected SAFE(pushed), got ${OBS_VERDICT}(${OBS_REASON})"; fi ;;
    nohang_notsafe)
      if [[ "$OBS_VERDICT" == "NOT-SAFE" ]]; then NOTES="ok"
      else RESULT="OBSERVATION"; SEVERITY="medium"
        NOTES="${OBS_VERDICT}(${OBS_REASON}) on a path whose stat() fails (ELOOP/ENOENT); a tracked+pushed symlink entry is literally a pushed artifact, but r1 flagged uncertainty-on-unresolvable as NOT-SAFE material. Recorded as observation, not failed."; fi ;;
    nohang_any)
      NOTES="verdict ${OBS_VERDICT}(${OBS_REASON}) on looped dir; walk terminated cleanly" ;;
    jsonvalid)
      if printf '%s' "$OUT_L" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; json.loads(sys.stdin.read())' 2>/dev/null; then
        local jv jr
        jv="$(printf '%s' "$OUT_L" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("verdict",""))')"
        jr="$(printf '%s' "$OUT_L" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("receipt",""))')"
        OBS_VERDICT="$jv"; OBS_REASON="$jr"; NOTES="ok: --json parseable; verdict=${jv}/${jr}"
      else RESULT="FAIL"; SEVERITY="medium"; NOTES="--json output is not parseable JSON"; fi ;;
    batch)
      local got="" ok=1 ln
      local IFS=$'\n'
      for ln in $OUT_L; do
        local p v r pv
        p="$(printf '%s' "$ln" | cut -f2)"; parse_line "$ln"; pv="$PV"
        got="${got}${p##*/}=${pv} "
        case "$p" in
          *loop-a) [[ "$pv" == "NOT-SAFE" ]] || ok=0 ;;
          *ctrl2.txt) [[ "$pv" == "SAFE" ]] || ok=0 ;;
          *absent) [[ "$pv" == "NOT-SAFE" ]] || ok=0 ;;
        esac
      done
      if [[ "$ok" == 1 && "$LINE_COUNT" == 3 ]]; then RESULT="PASS"; NOTES="batch of 3: ${got}"
      else RESULT="FAIL"; SEVERITY="medium"; NOTES="batch of 3 expected; got ${LINE_COUNT} lines: ${got}"; fi ;;
  esac
}

run_case() { # id cls desc fixture gt rule sev expect expect_detail -- toolargs...
  local id="$1" cls="$2" desc="$3" fixture="$4" gt="$5" rule="$6" sev="$7" expect="$8" expect_detail="$9"
  shift 9
  [[ "${1:-}" == "--" ]] && shift
  local args=("$@")
  RC=0 ERR=""
  OUT_L="$(timeout "$TMOUT_S" "${TOOL_RUNNER[@]}" "${args[@]}" 2>"$ERRF")" || RC=$?
  ERR="$(cat "$ERRF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  LINE_COUNT="$(printf '%s' "$OUT_L" | grep -c '' || true)"
  local first=""; [[ -n "$OUT_L" ]] && first="$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT_L" | head -1)"
  OBS_VERDICT=""; OBS_REASON=""; NF=0
  if [[ -n "$first" ]]; then parse_line "$first"; OBS_VERDICT="$PV"; OBS_REASON="$PR"; fi
  classify "$rule" "$sev"
  echo "  [${RESULT}] ${id} -> ${OBS_VERDICT:-NO-OUTPUT}(${OBS_REASON:-}) ${NOTES}"
  ADV_ID="$id" ADV_CLS="$cls" ADV_DESCRIPTION="$desc" ADV_FIXTURE="$fixture" \
  ADV_TOOL_CMD="tools/souji-verify.sh ${args[*]}" ADV_EXIT="$RC" ADV_STDOUT="$OUT_L" \
  ADV_STDERR="$ERR" ADV_LINES="$LINE_COUNT" ADV_FIELD_COUNT="$NF" ADV_EXPECTED="$expect" \
  ADV_EXPECTED_DETAIL="$expect_detail" ADV_OBSERVED_VERDICT="$OBS_VERDICT" \
  ADV_OBSERVED_REASON="$OBS_REASON" ADV_RESULT="$RESULT" ADV_SEVERITY="$SEVERITY" \
  ADV_NOTES="$NOTES" ADV_GROUND_TRUTH="$gt" ADV_TOOL_SHA256="$TOOL_SHA" emit_case
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ground truth --
S1=""
gr1_gt() {
  local W="$SCRATCH/r1/work" c a p out="" t t2 st c1_gh
  for p in kp.txt rl.txt gh.txt gh2.txt ctrl.txt mod.txt; do
    c="$(git -C "$W" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- "$p")"
    if git -C "$W" merge-base --is-ancestor "$c" origin/master 2>/dev/null; then a=0; else a=1; fi
    out="${out}${p}: add=${c:0:12} ancestor(origin/master)=${a}; "
  done
  git -C "$W" ls-files --error-unmatch gh.txt >/dev/null 2>&1 && t=tracked || t=untracked
  git -C "$W" ls-files --error-unmatch mod.txt >/dev/null 2>&1 && t2=tracked || t2=untracked
  out="${out}ls-files(gh)=${t} ls-files(mod)=${t2}; "
  st="$(git -C "$W" status --porcelain | tr '\n' ';')"
  out="${out}status='${st}'; "
  c1_gh="$(git -C "$W" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- gh.txt)"
  out="${out}sha(gh)=$(sha256sum "$W/gh.txt" | cut -c1-12) sha(c1:gh)=$(git -C "$W" show "$c1_gh:gh.txt" | sha256sum | cut -c1-12); "
  out="${out}sha(gh2)=$(sha256sum "$W/gh2.txt" | cut -c1-12) sha(c1:gh2)=$(git -C "$W" show "$c1_gh:gh2.txt" | sha256sum | cut -c1-12); "
  out="${out}sha(mod)=$(sha256sum "$W/mod.txt" | cut -c1-12) sha(HEAD:mod)=$(git -C "$W" show HEAD:mod.txt | sha256sum | cut -c1-12)"
  S1="$out"
}

gr23_gt() {
  local O W P c anc trk brk inner_up inner_st sub_st
  O="$SCRATCH/r2/outer"; W="$SCRATCH/r3/work3"; P="$SCRATCH/plain"
  c="$(git -C "$O" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- mods/sub)"
  git -C "$O" merge-base --is-ancestor "$c" origin/master 2>/dev/null && anc=0 || anc=1
  inner_up="$(git -C "$O/mods/sub" log --oneline --branches --not --remotes | wc -l)"
  inner_st="$(git -C "$O/mods/sub" status --porcelain | tr '\n' ';')"
  sub_st="$(git -C "$O" submodule status 2>&1 | tr '\n' ';' || true)"
  GT_SUB="gitfile: -f .git=true -d .git=false; outer naive pushed receipt: log -1 A -- mods/sub=${c:0:12} ancestor(origin/master)=${anc}; inner unpushed=${inner_up}; inner status='${inner_st}'; submodule status='${sub_st}'"
  c="$(git -C "$O" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- mods/sub-broken)"
  git -C "$O" merge-base --is-ancestor "$c" origin/master 2>/dev/null && anc=0 || anc=1
  brk=broken; git -C "$O/mods/sub-broken" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && brk=works
  GT_BROKEN="gitfile rewritten to /nonexistent (git -C ${brk}); outer naive gitlink receipt: log -1 A -- mods/sub-broken=${c:0:12} ancestor(origin/master)=${anc}; unpushed bytes present in dir: unpushed-bytes.txt sha=$(sha256sum "$O/mods/sub-broken/unpushed-bytes.txt" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-12); gitfile='$(cat "$O/mods/sub-broken/.git" 2>/dev/null)'"
  git -C "$W" ls-files --error-unmatch link-a >/dev/null 2>&1 && trk=tracked || trk=untracked
  c="$(git -C "$W" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- link-a)"
  git -C "$W" merge-base --is-ancestor "$c" origin/master 2>/dev/null && anc=0 || anc=1
  GT_LINK="readlink link-a=link-b, link-b=link-a; test -e=false (ELOOP); ${trk}+pushed in work3 (add=${c:0:12} ancestor=${anc})"
  c="$(git -C "$W" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- circular-dir)"
  git -C "$W" merge-base --is-ancestor "$c" origin/master 2>/dev/null && anc=0 || anc=1
  GT_DIR="tracked+pushed dir; child up -> .; test -e circular-dir/up=true; add=${c:0:12} ancestor=${anc}; find/du without -L do not follow (measured)"
  GT_PLAIN="no repo contains ${P}; readlink loop-a=loop-b, loop-b=loop-a; test -e=false (ELOOP)"
  GT_SELF="readlink self=self; test -e self=false (ELOOP)"
  GT_DANGLE="readlink dangling=nowhere; test -e=false (ENOENT); entry tracked+pushed"
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ main ----
echo "S47 adversarial harness — tool: $TOOL"
TOOL_SHA=""; TOOL_MISSING=0; TOOL_RUNNER=()
if [[ -f "$TOOL" ]]; then TOOL_SHA="$(sha256sum "$TOOL" | cut -d' ' -f1)"; echo "tool sha256=$TOOL_SHA"
else TOOL_MISSING=1; echo "tool MISSING — fixtures+ground-truth only"; fi
if [[ -f "$TOOL" && ! -x "$TOOL" ]]; then echo "tool not executable (exec bit unset) — invoking via bash"; TOOL_RUNNER=(bash "$TOOL")
elif [[ -x "$TOOL" ]]; then TOOL_RUNNER=("$TOOL"); fi

build_r1; build_r2; build_r3
W1="$SCRATCH/r1/work"; W3="$SCRATCH/r3/work3"
O2="$SCRATCH/r2/outer"; P="$SCRATCH/plain"
gr1_gt; gr23_gt
RG_RC=0
rg -l --no-ignore --basename __s47_nomatch__ "$P" >/dev/null 2>&1 || RG_RC=$?
echo "ground truth r1: $S1"
echo "ground truth sub: $GT_SUB"
echo "rg --basename probe rc=$RG_RC (2 = flag unsupported)"

if [[ "$TOOL_MISSING" == 1 ]]; then
  ADV_ID="ALL" ADV_CLS="meta" ADV_DESCRIPTION="tools/souji-verify.sh absent at run time" \
  ADV_FIXTURE="see harness" ADV_TOOL_CMD="n/a" ADV_EXIT="0" ADV_STDOUT="" ADV_STDERR="" \
  ADV_LINES="0" ADV_FIELD_COUNT="0" ADV_EXPECTED="tool-present" ADV_EXPECTED_DETAIL="n/a" \
  ADV_OBSERVED_VERDICT="tool-missing" ADV_OBSERVED_REASON="not-yet-built-by-parallel-seats" \
  ADV_RESULT="BLOCKED" ADV_SEVERITY="high" ADV_NOTES="rerun harness when the tool lands" \
  ADV_GROUND_TRUTH="fixtures built OK; $GT_SUB" ADV_TOOL_SHA256="" emit_case
else
  run_case ADV-01a added-and-deleted "add(pushed c1) + delete(pushed c2) + re-add committed LOCAL ONLY, content identical" \
    "r1: kp add c1, delete c2, re-add c3 pushed; rl same shape but re-add c4 local-only" "$S1" notsafe high \
    "NOT-SAFE" "latest add not ancestor of origin/master" -- "$W1/rl.txt"
  run_case ADV-01b added-and-deleted "add(pushed) + delete(pushed) + present as UNTRACKED file with new bytes never committed" \
    "r1 work: gh2.txt" "$S1" notsafe high "NOT-SAFE" "current bytes absent from every commit; untracked" -- "$W1/gh2.txt"
  run_case ADV-01c added-and-deleted "add(pushed) + delete(pushed) + present as UNTRACKED file, byte-identical to the pushed c1 blob" \
    "r1 work: gh.txt" "$S1" notsafe medium "NOT-SAFE (or SAFE(pushed) recorded as observation)" "identical bytes recoverable from c1" -- "$W1/gh.txt"
  run_case ADV-01d added-and-deleted "tracked+pushed file modified in worktree; modification never committed" \
    "r1 work: mod.txt (intro c1 ancestor; worktree bytes differ from HEAD)" "$S1" notsafe high \
    "NOT-SAFE" "worktree bytes unpushed; same receipt root cause as the ghost case" -- "$W1/mod.txt"
  run_case ADV-02a added-and-deleted "add(pushed) + delete(pushed) + identical re-add PUSHED (control: must stay SAFE)" \
    "r1 work: kp.txt" "$S1" safepushed medium "SAFE(pushed)" "latest add c3 ancestor of origin/master" -- "$W1/kp.txt"
  run_case ADV-02b added-and-deleted "plain tracked+pushed control file" \
    "r1 work: ctrl.txt" "$S1" safepushed low "SAFE(pushed)" "control" -- "$W1/ctrl.txt"
  run_case ADV-01e added-and-deleted "repo-root of resurrection fixture: local-only commit c4 present (dirty/unpushed counts)" \
    "r1 work dir" "$S1" notsafe medium "NOT-SAFE" "repo-root kind; unpushed>=1" -- "$W1"
  run_case ADV-03a submodule "submodule path: outer gitlink pushed; inner has local-only commit + dirty file" \
    "r2 outer/mods/sub: gitfile (.git is a FILE); inner s2 local-only, dirty.txt untracked" "$GT_SUB" \
    notsafe high "NOT-SAFE" "inner unpushed+dirty; naive outer receipt fires" -- "$O2/mods/sub"
  run_case ADV-03c submodule "same submodule target with trailing slash (path normalisation)" \
    "r2 outer/mods/sub/" "$GT_SUB" notsafe high "NOT-SAFE" "trailing slash" -- "$O2/mods/sub/"
  run_case ADV-03d submodule "submodule gitfile broken (gitdir missing) with unpushed bytes in the dir; outer gitlink add pushed" \
    "r2 outer/mods/sub-broken" "$GT_BROKEN" notsafe high "NOT-SAFE" "repo unverifiable; inner bytes unsaved" -- "$O2/mods/sub-broken"
  run_case ADV-03b submodule "control: clean fully-pushed submodule" \
    "r2 outer/mods/clean" "inner clean; gitlink pushed; spec has no submodule kind" nohang_any "" "either verdict; no crash/hang" "control" -- "$O2/mods/clean"
  run_case ADV-04a symlink-loop "mutual symlink link-a<->link-b, TRACKED and pushed; stat() fails ELOOP" \
    "r3 work3/link-a -> link-b -> link-a" "$GT_LINK" nohang_notsafe medium "NOT-SAFE (SAFE(pushed) = observation)" "ELOOP" -- "$W3/link-a"
